title: Tech Note: Styling Freeze Panes
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: VP SET FROZEN PANES / VP Get frozen panes
VP Font to object / VP Object to font
VP COLUMN AUTOFIT / VP ROW AUTOFIT

historical_commentary.text: This note documents freeze-pane styling commands added in 4D View Pro v18R2, which remain part of the current 4D View Pro API; the technique is still valid, though View Pro has continued to gain features since, so newer built-in styling options may reduce the need for this level of manual scripting.
related_updates: 4D View Pro (based on SpreadJS/GrapeCity) has continued to expand its command set across 4D releases; VP SET FROZEN PANES, VP SET CELL STYLE, VP Get/Set default style remain current commands
4D Write/View 'classic' plugins were long superseded — but this note is about 4D View Pro, which is itself the modern spreadsheet component, so it is not affected by that transition
